title: ShapeCast3D - incorrect collision calculations
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: Godot v4.5.1-1 ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 09 Jan 2026 19:43:48 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory ### Issue description I am using the `get_closest_collision_safe_fraction()` on the Node **`ShapeCast3D`** and it's behaviour is just so odd that I have to assume it's a bug: - Checked Area is the area to which the interval <0.0, 1.0> is calculated - Shape is a cylinder which height I've set to 2 × (origin -> target distance) I think the check should be performed either - between the origin & the target or - in the entire volume of the shape in the direction of the target Problem 2: Same setup with `collision_result` Array property read of the Node **`ShapeCast3D`** returns collision points inside as well as outside the shape - specifically 1/2 the height of the shape in the opposite vector to the target from origin In case my code could be the problem, all I did to get the data is ```gdscript $CollisionCheck.force_shapecast_update() print($CollisionCheck.get_closest_collision_safe_fraction()) print($CollisionCheck.collision_result) ``` ### Steps to reproduce - Make a Node **`ShapeCast3D`** - Assign 'CylinderShape' - Height 4.0m - Radius 0.4m - Target position.y: 2.0m - Transform position.y: -2.0m - Observe **`CollisionShape3D`** interactions from `get_closest_collision_safe_fraction()` & `collision_result` calls on the **`ShapeCast3D`** ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Check the console [test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24688902/test.zip)
